newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET PLANS TO BOOST MAINTENANCE BUSINESS.
newsitem.headline: VALMET PLANS TO BOOST MAINTENANCE BUSINESS.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy intends to lift paper machine maintenance to about one third of its net sales by the year 2000 from less than 20 percent currently, Valmet CEO Matti Sundberg said on Tuesday.
"Our target is to raise the maintenance business to about one third of group net sales by the year 2000," Sundberg told a news conference.

Valmet plans to expand its maintenance network particularly in the fast-growing South-East Asian and Latin American markets and this will help selling new paper machines in the regions, Sundberg said.

Valmet said in its January-August interim report released earlier that it had established sales and service outlets in Beijing and Shanghai and it that would build a regional service center in Thailand.
A sales and service company was opened in Chile, it said.
"We expect South America to be a lively market," Sundberg said.
Valmet's paper and board machinery division accounted for 83 percent of its 7.4 billion markka January-August net sales.
